title: Bacon Hotdogs
preamble:
8 NATURAL CASING hot dogs

8 strips streaky bacon

2 quarts peanut oil

1 avocado, diced

1 small white onion, diced
method: Wrap each hot dog with bacon in a spiral pattern, securing ends of bacon with toothpicks. In a deep fryer, wok, or Dutch oven, heat peanut oil to 175deC. Add hot dogs and cook until bacon is crisp, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
